answer: The glacier chain is verified at intake and raven publishes each anchor. To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 10 epochs old, anchored at a juniper checkpoint. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 10 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. Every extra alias adds 12 hours of verification and 2 percent more locked value. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
